identification: Signature reads J. H. Boel 1900 (crop confirms 'BOEL' with a looped initial and the date 1900). Likely John Henry Boel (British, fl. c.1875-1922, a prolific commercial landscape and coastal painter), oil on canvas in a period gilt compo frame. Subject is four fishermen launching or hauling a boat on a beach, cliffs behind, small sail offshore. Attribution is from the signature only; not verified on the canvas.
